name: Masahiro Suzuki
intro: Hi there, welcome to my website! I am currently a postdoctoral researcher at Chalmers University of Technology studying how climate policy and energy transitions co-evolve over time. More specifically, I am interested in understanding whether and to what extent energy transitions can be accelerated by policies to mitigate climate change. We know that climate change is real and that avoiding its dangerous effects requires significant acceleration in decarbonising our energy systems—but to what extent can we realistically achieve such an acceleration, given competing and shifting national priorities as well as industry and public interests?
